breakpointLegend: Vertical lines mark where each responsive size begins.
breakpointGuidesVisible: Breakpoint guides and legend are visible
breakpointGuidesHidden: Breakpoint guides and legend are hidden
modulesDescription: Check each module's loading status, prepare it, or open its routes.
applicationStatesDescription: Preview common loading and error screens without changing the real app state.
notificationToastErrorMessage: This sample notification reports an error.
tutorialFlagsReset: Tutorial flags reset. Use a tutorial's Start button to run it now.
allModulesComplete: All visible modules are now marked complete.
progressAllNextCheckpoints: Advance each expedition by one checkpoint
expeditionsAdvanced_one: Advanced one expedition by one checkpoint.
allExpeditionsAlreadyComplete: All visible expeditions are already complete.
allTutorialsComplete: All tutorials are now marked complete.
allExpeditionsStarted: All visible expeditions are now started.
confirmResetJournalDescription: This clears every started expedition and field note saved in this browser. It can't be undone.
confirmResetSiteDescription: This clears the saved journal and both tutorial flags, then reloads the site as if you were a first-time visitor. It can't be undone.
tutorialsDescription: Start each tutorial now or reset its saved flag for a later visit.
introTutorialFlagReset: Intro tutorial flag reset. Reload the page or use Start this tutorial to run it.
mediaPlayerTutorialFlagReset: Media player tutorial flag reset. Reload the page or use Start this tutorial to run it.
mediaPlayerTutorialStarted: Media tutorial started if a track is open; otherwise, it will start when you open one.
